newsitem.title: USA: Rent-Way sells debentures, buys stores.
newsitem.headline: Rent-Way sells debentures, buys stores.

text.p: Rent-Way Inc said Thursday it had completed a $20 million private placement sale of seven percent convertible subordinated debentures and also acquired a chain of stores.

The firm said the debentures, which are due in 2007, are non-callable for three years and are convertible into common stock at a rate of $13.37 per share, which equates to an aggregate of about 1.5 million shares of the company's common stock, it said.
The company said it used the proceeds from the sale to help finance its $23-million acquisition of a chain of 70 rental-purchase stores, which will increase monthly revenues to about $8 million .
Rent-Way signed a definitive agreement late last month to acquire the stores from Rental-King.
